stem:
Normal cells have a contact inhibition feedback mechanism that prevents the cells from replicating when other cells are touched. A diagram of cells with contact inhibition and cells without contact inhibition is shown.

Which statement best describes what will happen to cells in an organism that lack contact inhibition?

options.label: A
options.text: The cells will continue to grow, causing a tumor in the body.

options.label: B
options.text: The cells will replicate normally, replacing body cells that die.

options.label: C
options.text: The cells will replicate until the food supply for each cell is used, causing each cell to die.

options.label: D
options.text: The cells will stop replicating once one layer is produced, as other body cells will crowd them out.

visual_elements: Diagram: Two petri dishes labeled 'Cells with Contact Inhibition' and 'Cells without Contact Inhibition'. Each has a top view and side view. The 'Cells with Contact Inhibition' dish shows a uniform single layer of cells. The 'Cells without Contact Inhibition' dish shows clumped cells piled above a single layer.
